title: My reflection blinked late 🪞
style_prompt: dark blue cinematic night, faceless silhouette, fog, minimal interior, no text, no watermark
hook_text: At 2:31 in the morning, my reflection blinked after I did.

scenes.narration: At 2:31 in the morning, my reflection blinked after I did.
Just a fraction of a second. I told myself I was tired. I raised my hand. The reflection raised its hand, a little late.
I stepped back into the hallway, to the tall mirror by the door. Same delay. Longer now.
One second. Two. I waved, and counted. Three. Then the reflection waved back.
I ran my hand over the glass. The reflection did not. It simply stood there. Watching my hand.
My phone buzzed. A text from my own number. Stop moving. It is hard enough to copy you.
I froze. In the mirror, the reflection froze too. But its eyes were not on me. They were on the room behind me.
Slowly, it lifted one finger to its lips. Be quiet. Something is walking down the hallway.
I heard slow footsteps. Behind me. Getting closer. And in the glass, the reflection was shaking its head. Slowly. Pleading.
So tell me. Do you smash the mirror, or leave it?
